name: Typical Timelines for Kitchen Remodels and Garage-to-ADU Conversions in Los Angeles

mainEntity.name: What are realistic timelines from first consultation to completion for a typical Los Angeles kitchen remodel versus a garage-to-ADU conversion?
mainEntity.text: What are realistic timelines from first consultation to completion for a typical Los Angeles kitchen remodel versus a garage-to-ADU conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary widely, but homeowners often underestimate how long major projects in Los Angeles take when you include planning and permitting. For a **typical kitchen remodel** (no major additions or structural changes), expect 1–3 months for design, product selections, and ordering cabinets and fixtures. Once construction begins, demolition to final punch list commonly takes **2–4 months**, depending on complexity, inspection schedules, and material lead times. A **garage-to-ADU conversion** is more involved because it creates a new dwelling unit. Design and engineering can take 1–3 months, followed by several weeks to a few months for permitting, depending on city workload and how complete the initial submittal is. Construction itself can run **4–6 months or more**, especially if significant structural upgrades, utility trenching, and interior finishes are required. Overall, it is not unusual for an ADU project to span **9–12 months** from first consultation to move-in. Building in time for design revisions, city corrections, and unforeseen site conditions will lead to more realistic expectations and smoother planning for your family or tenants.
